_meta.read_rule: Every entry was read by an AI agent from one sample file per group; other files of the group were not opened. Archives (.zip) and videos were not downloaded or opened. No value was read into a standard variable: a mapping names a header, never a value.
_meta.mapping_by: AI reading of the header, not confirmed by a document
_meta.mapping_rule: A header is mapped to a standard variable only when its text names the variable's quantity (unit differences are noted). A column of a different quantity, location or event, or a column with no values in the sampled file, is not a column for the variable: it is listed under 'related_columns_not_mapped' with the reason, and is not counted. Where several statistics exist for one variable, each is listed with its header and the note says they are different statistics. 'column_is' is one of the words of '_meta.column_is', decided from the file and the checker review. The header is compared with the meaning of the variable in spec/variables.json, including its moment and volume (second checker review, 2026-11-14): a header of another quantity (a sensor series of CO2 against carbon dioxide added before the test) or another moment that the definition excludes (a final flow against the flow at the start) is not an entry; a header of the quantity that differs in a way listed in _meta.differs_from_definition stays an entry and carries the code.

effect.rule: Nothing here changes a pipeline output. Saffire: the lowest and the highest stored reading of column 'Ambient Pressure' of each linked workbook (data/pipeline/raw_values.csv) are converted with the factor below and placed in the pressure bins of spec/coverage.json and the pressure ranges of spec/scenarios.json. SAME-R: the stored values of raw_values.csv that are tied to a test are counted per size statistic; a stored 0 and an error string are not counted as a value.
effect.factor_source: spec/findings.json _meta.units.psi_to_kpa (1 psi = 6.894757 kPa); the rules for the experimental tables (spec/sources.json) hold no psia factor
effect.arithmetic: The conversion of the lowest and the highest reading (reading x factor, rounded to 4 decimals) is the only arithmetic. No mean, no value at ignition and no interpolation is computed.
effect.same_bin: The lowest and the highest reading fall in the same pressure bin. The series does not say which reading is the pressure of the test.
effect.different_bin: The lowest and the highest reading fall in different pressure bins, so the series does not determine a bin.
effect.choice: Which reading would stand for a test (the first, the lowest, the one at ignition) is a choice that no file makes; no column of the workbooks states when the flame ignited. The sensor workbooks have igniter channels (for example 'Igniter Current', 'Igniter Voltage', 'Igniter Power Enable'), which were not read.
effect.d2_count: The count of D2 does not change: no value is adopted, so tests.csv holds no smoke_particle_size_um and D2 keeps no counted test. If one statistic were adopted as smoke_particle_size_um, a D2 test would be counted only where it also meets every required condition (fuel_material, flow_cms, aging_time_s) under a supported link; 'statistics' gives that number per statistic. Headers without a unit (AMD, CMD, Hatch Choate Dg) would also need a unit stated by a document, and the investigators name more than one statistic, so choosing one is part of the decision.
effect.not_adopted: Not adopted: a decision of the team's human lead.
effect.statistic_names: The keys of same_statistic_classes are the team's short names for groups of stored headers. The cells say only 'M1/M0 (micro-m)--AMD' or '--CMD'; where both labels exist for one test inside the results workbook the stored values are equal, which is why they are one group; what AMD and CMD stand for is not written in the workbook. 'Hatch Choate Dg' has no unit in any header; sheet 'ICES 2012 Paper data table' holds 0.09 in M5 (Hatch Choate Dg) next to 90 in Q5 ('Geom.Mean Diam. (nm)'), and the workbook does not state the unit. A key is a stored header name, not the quantity smoke_particle_size_um.
effect.files_differ: For every test with stored values in both the results workbook and the TEM workbook the values of the same statistic differ: the TEM cells are cached values of external references to a version of the results workbook that is not in PSI ([2]SAME R Results), and its 'Hatch Choate Dg' column O refers to column BM, which in the PSI results workbook is headed 'Hatch Choate Sigma g' (BM2), not 'Hatch Choate Dg' (BN2). A test counts as having a value if one positive value is stored in either file, whether or not the files agree.
effect.kpa_note: min_kpa and max_kpa are a unit conversion of the lowest and the highest stored reading of a whole logging window of one workbook (one per sample); they are not a test pressure, not the pressure at ignition, and no column states when the flame ignited.

differs_from_definition.reading_not_marked: a sensor series over a logging window; no column of the file marks the reading that the variable's definition names (the start of the test) or that would stand for one test, so a value per test needs a choice that no file makes
differs_from_definition.moment_not_as_defined: the header names the quantity at another moment than the definition (at ignition, where the definition says at the start of the test)
differs_from_definition.location_not_stated: the header stands under a label of another volume (the ISS cabin), and the file does not say that the test volume had this value
differs_from_definition.magnitude_not_as_unit_written: the cells hold numbers whose magnitude does not fit the unit the header writes (fractions under a percent header)
differs_from_definition.unit_not_written: the header and its unit cell give no unit
differs_from_definition.one_of_several_statistics: the file holds several statistics of the quantity under different headers; the variable does not name one, so choosing one is a decision

link_kind.literal_key_or_label: a key or a label printed in the opened file, or in its name, equals the value of a column of the experimental table for one row (sample label, test number, identifier); the files of the group that were not opened were not checked
link_kind.not_settled: the tie holds for some opened files and not for others, or the key is not unique in the table
link_kind.no_per_test_row: the experimental table has no per-test row (one row per test day), so no file can be tied to a test row
link_kind.not_evident: the file prints no key that ties it to a row
